47642-the-strand-magazine-vol-27-februar.creator: A. Conan Doyle.
47642-the-strand-magazine-vol-27-februar.description: A book by A. Conan Doyle.. e closed eyes were leaden in colour, the loose mouth drooped dolorously at the corners, the rolling chins were unshaven. Collar and shirt bore the grime of a long journey, and the hair bristled unkempt from the well-shaped head. It was a sorely-stricken man who lay before us. "What is it, Watson?" asked Holmes. "Absolute exhaustion--possibly mere hunger and fatigue," said I, with my finger on the thready pulse, where the stream of life trickled thin and small.

60951-the-service.description: A book by Henry David Thoreau. ness as when we would erect a stupendous piece of art, and send far and near for materials, intending to lay the foundations deeper, and rear the structure higher than ever; for hence results only a remarkable bulkiness without grandeur, lacking those true and simple proportions which are independent of size.

arxiv-2006-14846.title: A class of normal dilation matrices affirming the Marcus-de Oliveira conjecture Thanks: Keywords: Normal dilation, Normal matrices, Marcus de Oliveira Conjecture MSC(2010): 15A15; 15A60; 15A86
arxiv-2006-14846.creator: Kijti Rodtes
arxiv-2006-14846.description: Abstract . In this article, we prove a class of normal dilation matrices affirming the Marcus-de Oliveira conjecture. Throughout, n will denote a positive integer. The determinant conjecture of Marcus and de Oliveira states that the determinant of the sum of two n by n normal matrices A and B belongs to the convex hull of the n!

arxiv-2012-13343.title: Physics guided machine learning using simplified theories
arxiv-2012-13343.creator: Suraj Pawar, Omer San, Burak Aksoylu, Adil Rasheed, Trond Kvamsdal
arxiv-2012-13343.description: Abstract Recent applications of machine learning, in particular deep learning, motivate the need to address the generalizability of the statistical inference approaches in physical sciences. In this letter, we introduce a modular physics guided machine learning framework to improve the accuracy of such data-driven predictive engines.

arxiv-2102-07850.title: Differentiable Particle Filtering via Entropy-Regularized Optimal Transport
arxiv-2102-07850.creator: Adrien Corenflos, James Thornton, George Deligiannidis, Arnaud Doucet
arxiv-2102-07850.description: Abstract Particle Filtering (PF) methods are an established class of procedures for performing inference in non-linear state-space models. Resampling is a key ingredient of PF, necessary to obtain low variance likelihood and states estimates. However, traditional resampling methods result in PF-based loss functions being non-differentiable with respect to model and PF parameters.

arxiv-2112-15380.title: Tail processes and tail measures: An approach via Palm calculus
arxiv-2112-15380.creator: Günter Last
arxiv-2112-15380.description: Abstract Using an intrinsic approach, we study some properties of random fields which appear as tail fields of regularly varying stationary random fields. The index set is allowed to be a general locally compact Hausdorff Abelian group 𝔾 {\mathbb{G}} . The values are taken in a measurable cone, equipped with a pseudo norm.

arxiv-2308-00521.title: SurveyLM: a platform to explore emerging value perspectives in Augmented Language Models’ behaviors
arxiv-2308-00521.creator: Steve J. Bickley, Ho Fai Chan, Bang Dao, Benno Torgler, Son Tran
arxiv-2308-00521.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Steve J. Bickley, Ho Fai Chan, Bang Dao, Benno Torgler, Son Tran. This white paper presents our work on SurveyLM, a platform for analyzing augmented language models’ (ALMs) emergent alignment behaviors through their dynamically evolving attitude and value perspectives in complex social contexts. Social Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems, like ALMs, often function within nuanced social scenarios where there is no singular correct response, or where an answer is heavily dependent on contextual factors, thus necessitating an in-depth understanding of their alignment dynamics.

arxiv-2407-02031.description: Abstract . This paper documents our characterization study and practices for serving text-to-image requests with stable diffusion models in production. We first comprehensively analyze inference request traces for commercial text-to-image applications. It commences with our observation that add-on modules, i.e., ControlNets and LoRAs, that augment the base stable diffusion models, are ubiquitous in generating images for commercial applications.

arxiv-2410-13587.title: A Sequential Game Framework for Target Tracking
arxiv-2410-13587.creator: 1 st Daniel Leal, 2 nd Ngoc Hung Nguyen, 3 rd Alex Skvortsov, 4 th Sanjeev Arulampalam, 5 th Mahendra Piraveenan*
arxiv-2410-13587.description: Abstract This paper investigates the application of game-theoretic principles combined with advanced Kalman filtering techniques to enhance maritime target tracking systems. Specifically, the paper presents a two-player, imperfect information, non-cooperative, sequential game framework for optimal decision making for a tracker and an evader.

arxiv-2507-18947.title: GEAR: Gaze-Enabled Human-Robot Collaborative Assembly
arxiv-2507-18947.creator: Asad Ali Shahid, Angelo Moroncelli, Drazen Brscic, Takayuki Kanda, Loris Roveda
arxiv-2507-18947.description: Abstract Recent progress in robot autonomy and safety has significantly improved human-robot interactions, enabling robots to work alongside humans on various tasks. However, complex assembly tasks still present significant challenges due to inherent task variability and the need for precise operations.

arxiv-2601-03850.title: Investigating the Grounding Bottleneck for a Large-Scale Configuration Problem: Existing Tools and Constraint-Aware Guessing
arxiv-2601-03850.creator: Veronika Semmelrock, Gerhard Friedrich
arxiv-2601-03850.description: Abstract Answer set programming (ASP) aims to realize the AI vision: The user specifies the problem, and the computer solves it. Indeed, ASP has made this vision true in many application domains. However, will current ASP solving techniques scale up for large configuration problems?

pmc-11455419.title: 6626 Fertility considerations in Klinefelter Syndrome complicated by hypogonadotrophic hypogonadism
pmc-11455419.creator: Mauli Govinna, Stella Sarlos, Carolyn A Allan, Rinky Giri
pmc-11455419.description: Disclosure: M. Govinna: None. S. Sarlos: None. C.A. Allan: None. R. Giri: None. Background: Klinefelter syndrome (KS) remains underdiagnosed with less than 50% of men ever diagnosed and >90% of diagnoses only occurring when fertility is sought. MicroTESE (microscopic testicular sperm extraction) is now successful in 47-69% [1]. Optimal timing of the procedure is uncertain.

pmc-11675495.title: Preparation of Chitosan Oleogel from Capillary Suspension and Its Application in Pork Meatballs
pmc-11675495.creator: Shishuai Wang, Zhongqin Fan, Xinya Huang, Yue Gao, Hongwei Sui, Jun Yang, Bin Li
pmc-11675495.description: In the oil dispersion of chitosan, the formation of a capillary bridge was triggered by adding a small amount of water to obtain an oleogel. With this method, the types of liquid oil and the ratio of oil/chitosan/water were explored to achieve an optimal oleogel. MCT performed best, followed by soybean oil, which was chosen for its edibility and cost.

pmc-11709330.title: The Potential of Non‐invasive Neurostimulation, tDCS for Cognitive Decline in Alzheimer’s Disease: Through the Lens of an Ongoing Clinical Trial
pmc-11709330.creator: Jordan Vanzyl, Ivan Zhen, Kevin Ha, Itzel Flores, Melany Taranto, Mairim Melecio‐Vazquez, Emmeline Ayers, Erica Weiss, Jessica L Zwerling, Helena M Blumen, Joe Verghese, Helena Knotkova
pmc-11709330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTranscranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) is a non‐invasive neuromodulation method. Short‐term tDCS protocols have shown positive effects on cognitive outcomes in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) populations1‐5. Less is known about the long‐term benefits of tDCS on cognition in AD. Here, we discuss the evidence on efficacy of tDCS in AD and the potential of this novel technique applied in home settings6‐8 through the lens of our ongoing long‐term, large‐scale (N = 100) randomized controlled clinical trial in patients with mild‐to‐moderate AD.

pmc-12437791.title: Ethnoterritorial features of paranoid schizophrenia with comorbid dependence on synthetic cannabinoids
pmc-12437791.creator: N Bokhan, G Selivanov
pmc-12437791.description: IntroductionIt is indisputable that against the background of the popularity of various chemical addictions among patients with schizophrenia, it is relevant to study the joint clinical and pathomorphological deformation of two nosological phenomena of paranoid schizophrenia and dependence on modern, increasingly popular drugs, synthetic cannabinoids in various ethno-territorial groups.

pmc-12439807.title: A novel APOL1 membrane-addressing domain mutation (p.T272I) in Chinese twins with FSGS: implications for podocyte injury and ion channel disruption
pmc-12439807.creator: Ting Peng, Dan Chang, Tingyu Chen, Sipei Chen, Li Wang, Guisen Li
pmc-12439807.description: Apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1) risk variants are strongly associated with kidney diseases, including focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS), though known mutations (G1/G2) are primarily observed in African populations. This study reports a novel APOL1 mutation (p.T272I) identified in a pair of Chinese twins with FSGS, expanding the genetic spectrum of APOL1-related nephropathies.

pmc-12559473.title: Cold‐Captured Dynamic Hydration Networks in Oxime‐Based Photoswitches: A Theoretical Challenge Uncovered by Rotational Spectroscopy
pmc-12559473.creator: Rita J. C. Roque, Nuno M. Campos, Marcos Gouveia, Sérgio R. Domingos
pmc-12559473.description: With the goal of manipulating (bio)chemical processes, photoswitches emerge as important assets in molecular nanotechnology. To guide synthetic strategies toward increasingly more efficient systems, conformational dynamics studies performed with atomic rigor are in demand, particularly if this information can be extracted with control over the size of a perturbing solvation layer.

pmc-12971721.title: The gut resistome in poultry production: microbial ecology, antibiotic use, and sustainable control approaches
pmc-12971721.creator: Zonghui Jian, Yuwei Qian, Shichun He, Ruohan Zhao, Ke Li, Jinlong Cha, Zhijun Ning, Yanlin Ye, Zhipeng Bao, Kun Wang, Changrong Ge, Junjing Jia, Tengfei Dou, Yuanyuan Hu, Xiaoming He, Xiannian Zi
pmc-12971721.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Antibiotics remain central to modern poultry production, but their long-term and sometimes poorly managed use has markedly altered gut microbial ecology, effectively transforming the intestine into a substantial reservoir of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). In poultry, the composition of ARGs reflects not only resistant bacterial taxa but also the activity of mobile genetic elements, shifts in gut metabolic conditions, and features of the surrounding production system.

pmc-13127415.title: The “healthy dyad” bias in veteran-caregiver dyadic research: a methodological caution
pmc-13127415.creator: Alisa Bedrov, Erin D Bouldin, Roxana E Delgado, Mary Jo Pugh, Michelle Putnam
pmc-13127415.description: ve view of the interdependent dynamics within relationships. This study highlights a potential “healthy dyad” bias that systematically underrepresents caregivers who are experiencing higher caregiver burden and lower mental health and social well-being. Future studies should critically consider how caregiver-care recipient dyads are recruited and the generalizability of those findings to caregivers, patients, and other populations.

pmc-13184144.title: NT5DC2 inhibits ferroptosis by stabilizing ACSL3 in bladder cancer
pmc-13184144.creator: Shaorui Niu, Pang Yang, Yuyang Yao, Xiaofeng Tang, Jun Yang, Feifei Zhang, Kangming Chen, Chengli Jiang, Yuhao Zhou, Wei Bai, Liping Li, Yuntong Zhou, Xiao-Bin Lv
pmc-13184144.description: Ferroptosis, a form of regulated cell death, plays a pivotal role in the development and treatment of cancer because of its impact on tumor cell proliferation, differentiation, and resistance to chemotherapy. NT5DC2, a gene associated with ferroptosis, has been identified as a key facilitator of cellular proliferation and metastasis in several cancers.

pmc-13611738.title: Changes in Attack Execution Following a Fencing-Specific Training Program in Competitive Male Sabre Fencers: An Exploratory Study
pmc-13611738.creator: Rareș Dumitrescu, Denisa-Iulia Brus, Ștefan Teriș, Răzvan-Sandu Enoiu
pmc-13611738.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Attack execution is a fundamental determinant of performance in sabre fencing, requiring athletes to integrate technical precision, tactical decision-making, perceptual abilities, and neuromuscular control within extremely short time intervals. The purpose of this exploratory single-group pre–post study was to investigate changes in attack execution, balance, postural control, and movement accuracy following an eight-week fencing-specific training program in competitive male sabre fencers.

pmc-13629243.title: Health Literacy and Unmet Needs in Patients With Multiple Sclerosis: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13629243.creator: Francesco Pastore, Barbara Forastefano, Valentina Simonetti, Tommaso Guerra, Giancarlo Cicolini, Pietro Iaffaldano, Dania Comparcini
pmc-13629243.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13672250.title: Controlling Epitaxial Zn Growth via Guided Laser Patterning toward High‐Performance 6Ah Aqueous Zn||I2 Batteries
pmc-13672250.creator: Suyeon Kim, Dongjae Kim, Youngeun Kim, Chaejeong Kim, Myunghyun Ryu, Wooyoung Jin, Hyeokjin Kwon, Kyu‐Nam Jung, Ki Jae Kim, Jong‐Won Lee, Jinhong Lee
pmc-13672250.description: Aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs) are attractive for grid‐scale energy storage because of their safety, low cost, and environmental benignity. However, their practical use is limited by interfacial instability at the Zn anode, which induces nonuniform Zn2+ flux, dendritic growth, and parasitic H2 evolution. Herein, we present a laser‐induced surface patterning stategy that guides Zn epitaxial growth through a resistance‐gradient‐driven mechanism.

pmc-13723769.title: Firearms, storage practices, and child blood lead levels and household dust lead loadings: findings from the HOME study
pmc-13723769.creator: Christian Hoover, Yingying Xu, Bruce Lanphear, Kimberly Yolton, Nicholas Newman, Joseph M. Braun
pmc-13723769.description: BACKGROUND:Lead is a persistent environmental toxicant associated with adverse neurodevelopmental and behavioral outcomes, with children particularly vulnerable due to heightened exposure and biological susceptibility. Although population blood lead levels in U.S. children have declined substantially, a large proportion remain above levels associated with harm, indicating ongoing exposure from additional sources.
